_meta.what: MLCC DC-bias derating for every capacitor on the Brain Canvas Rev.A board.
_meta.why: Class-II ceramics (X5R/X7R) lose a large fraction of their marked capacitance under DC bias. A 2.2 uF 6.3 V 0402 biased at 2.5 V is not a 2.2 uF capacitor, and the LDO stability, rail-ripple and power-on-delay answers all turn on the real number rather than the printed one.
_meta.bias_retention: volts (as string) -> Ceff/Cnom from the manufacturer curve at 25 C, typical sample. Linear interpolation between points; clamped outside. Values slightly above 1.0 at 0 V are real: a typical sample sits above its marked value.
_meta.bias_retention_worst_case: the same curve multiplied by the tolerance low limit and by 0.85 for the X5R/X7R temperature coefficient (+-15 %). Use this for a worst-case corner; sim/cases read it when SIM_CAP_WORST_CASE=1.
_meta.trusted: true = taken from a manufacturer DC-bias curve. false = documented engineering estimate.
_meta.esr_100k_ohm: series resistance at 100 kHz and 0 V bias, ohm. esl_H: bare-chip series inductance; board pads and vias add a further 0.5-1.5 nH.
_meta.source_note: Rows marked 'samsung weblib fetched 2026-08-29' come from Samsung Electro-Mechanics' own characteristic-curve service (weblib.samsungsem.com), 25 C, typical sample.
surprises_worth_knowing: The rule of thumb 'a 50 V part used at 5 V does not derate' is FALSE for CL31A106KBHNNNE (C13585): -4 % at 3.3 V and -20 % at 5 V.
CL05A105KA5NQNC (C52923) is a 25 V part and still loses 38 % at 3.3 V. It is C_EN_DLY, and the ESP32 power-on reset delay is computed from it.
CL31A107MQHNNNE (C15008) is already at 91 uF of its marked 100 uF at zero bias (M = +-20 %), and keeps only 41 % at 3.3 V - the weakest of the eight.

C1588.source: ESTIMATE: 1 nF 50 V X7R 0603 used at <= 5 V. Bias derating for a low-CV X7R this far below its rating is negligible; the sibling 50 V X7R rows that WERE fetched (C15195, C23967) both show retention at or above 1.0 across this range, which supports the estimate. These are the input common-mode capacitors and appear only in drl_loop.py, where the result is insensitive to them.

C237168.source: C0G/NP0 is a class-I dielectric: capacitance is independent of DC bias by definition of the dielectric class (EIA RS-198), and its temperature coefficient is 0 +/- 30 ppm/K. No curve needed.

C23733.note: Pending BOM change: replaces C12530 at C_NLDO_OUT and C_LM_IN. At 2.5 V bias it is 3.02 uF effective against C12530's 1.19 uF, i.e. 2.5x more real capacitance, with ESR falling 42.3 -> 21.1 mohm at 100 kHz. TPS72325 new silicon specifies Cout ESR 0-0.5 ohm (SLVS346E 7.1.3/5.3), so the lower ESR stays inside the stable region.
